//Myth: Where the colony writes its story. Rewrite that file and the colony tells your version from then on; leave one there before starting and a new colony begins with it.
//Save: Colonies themselves, in one SQLite file. The running colony writes itself under 'autosave' every colony day and on the way out, so an unplanned stop costs a day rather than a run. Set AutosaveEveryColonyDays to 0 to turn that off.
//Chronicle: The account of each session, amended every colony day and never read back by the game. The colony is saved separately — this is the readable record of it.

Mind.//Endpoint: Where inference happens. Local by default; point it at another machine and nothing else changes, because every mind call carries its whole context and the server holds no colony state.
